Taylor: Postmortem follow-up: need owners for customer comms + decision on RCA sharing. Quick sync here.
Maya: I'll write the 72-hour redacted customer summary. Plan: timeline + impact + three bullet fixes + contact CTA.
Omar: I'll draft the statuspage two-liner. Keep it non-technical and include the 72h note.

Taylor: Good. Maya, include this consent blurb: "Full RCA available to verified affected customers under existing confidentiality terms; contact support to request."
Maya: Will do. Also adding FAQ line: "Redacted: internal identifiers and sensitive logs removed; factual timeline preserved."
Omar: Draft statuspage snippet:
```
Status: Partial outage affecting inference API (us-west-2).
Impact: Elevated latency and errors for a subset of requests between 02:1002:45 UTC. Current status: Service restored for most customers; a redacted summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```
Becky: Suggest "Service restored for most customers" -> "Service restored for the majority of customers" to be safe. Legal approves the consent blurb.
OpsBot: @Rishi Recurrence job PRD-5122 created and scheduled.
CS-Team: We'll prepare an enterprise outreach template and coordinate send after legal sign-off.
